pd42s1_init.message0: PD42S1 init TX pin %1 RX pin %2 baud %3
pd42s1_init.tooltip: Initialize Serial1 for the PD42S1 bus; default pins 19/20 (DNESP32S3 wiring), change for other boards; default baud 115200

pd42s1_read.message0: read %1 motor addr %2 ack timeout %3 ms
pd42s1_read.tooltip: Send the read command, wait for the reply and print the parsed result on Serial; positions count 51200 per turn

pd42s1_handle_ack.message0: wait & process driver ack timeout %1 ms
pd42s1_handle_ack.tooltip: Wait for the driver ack frame, parse and print it (ends after timeout); use after send commands

pd42s1_torque_mode.message0: motor addr %1 torque mode dir %2 current %3 mA
pd42s1_torque_mode.tooltip: Closed-loop torque: direction + target current 0-3000 mA; current rises to target only under load

pd42s1_speed_mode.message0: motor addr %1 speed mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM
pd42s1_speed_mode.tooltip: Closed-loop speed: direction + accel 0-200 RPM/s (0 = instant start) + speed 0.1-3000 RPM

pd42s1_pos_mode.message0: motor addr %1 absolute position mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM pulses %5
pd42s1_pos_mode.tooltip: Closed-loop absolute position: dir + acc + max speed 0-3000 RPM + target pulses (51200 per turn)

pd42s1_pos_rel_mode.message0: motor addr %1 relative position mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM pulses %5
pd42s1_pos_rel_mode.tooltip: Closed-loop relative position: move the given pulses from the current position (51200 per turn), repeatable

pd42s1_pulse_mode.tooltip: Switch to pulse mode: controlled by EN/STP/DIR pins (you must output pulses separately)

pd42s1_pw_pos_mode.message0: motor addr %1 pulse-width position mode max pulse width %2 us min pulse width %3 us pos at max width %4 pos at min width %5
pd42s1_pw_pos_mode.tooltip: Pulse-width position (servo-like): PWM high width maps linearly to position; widths must not be 0

pd42s1_pw_ma_mode.message0: motor addr %1 pulse-width torque mode max pulse width %2 us min pulse width %3 us current at max width %4 mA current at min width %5 mA
pd42s1_pw_ma_mode.tooltip: Pulse-width torque mode: PWM high width maps linearly to current 0-3000 mA; widths must not be 0

pd42s1_pw_speed_mode.message0: motor addr %1 pulse-width speed mode max pulse width %2 us min pulse width %3 us speed at max width %4 RPM speed at min width %5 RPM
pd42s1_pw_speed_mode.tooltip: Pulse-width speed mode: PWM high width maps linearly to speed; widths must not be 0

pd42s1_ol_speed_mode.message0: motor addr %1 open-loop speed mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM
pd42s1_ol_speed_mode.tooltip: Open-loop speed (no position feedback): dir + acc + speed 0.1-3000 RPM

pd42s1_ol_pos_mode.message0: motor addr %1 open-loop absolute position mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM pulses %5
pd42s1_ol_pos_mode.tooltip: Open-loop absolute position: runs to the target by pulses without encoder feedback

pd42s1_ol_pos_rel_mode.message0: motor addr %1 open-loop relative position mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM pulses %5
pd42s1_ol_pos_rel_mode.tooltip: Open-loop relative position: relative move by pulses from current position, no encoder feedback

pd42s1_ol_pulse_mode.tooltip: Switch to open-loop pulse mode: controlled by EN/STP/DIR pins (output pulses separately)

pd42s1_io_run_ctrl.message0: motor addr %1 IO start-stop mode dir %2 acc %3 speed %4 RPM
pd42s1_io_run_ctrl.tooltip: IO start-stop mode: run with dir/acc/speed, started by the driver IO pin level (set IO start level first)

pd42s1_stop_now.tooltip: Stop immediately with braking; clear the motor state soon after braking or the motor may overheat

pd42s1_clear_sta.tooltip: Clear stall, disable and brake state flags

pd42s1_motor_enable.tooltip: Enable or disable the motor; when disabled the shaft spins freely

pd42s1_angle_zero.tooltip: Zero the current position (best done when the motor is stopped)

pd42s1_remove_clog.tooltip: Release the stall-protection lock and restore motor operation

pd42s1_cal_encoder.tooltip: Calibrate the encoder zero; the motor moves slightly during calibration, keep power on

pd42s1_reset_factory.tooltip: Factory reset; wait for the motor to stop afterwards (parameters re-identified)

pd42s1_param_save.tooltip: Save current parameters to the driver's non-volatile memory

pd42s1_set_slave_add.message0: motor addr %1 set slave addr to %2
pd42s1_set_slave_add.tooltip: Set the motor slave address (1-255); use the new address afterwards

pd42s1_set_group_add.message0: motor addr %1 set group addr to %2
pd42s1_set_group_add.tooltip: Set the group address to control multiple motors with one command

pd42s1_set_mode.tooltip: Set the driver work mode (comm / pulse / pulse-width / homing / open-loop series)

pd42s1_set_pos_pid.message0: motor addr %1 set position PID Kp %2 Ki %3 Kd %4

pd42s1_set_speed_pid.message0: motor addr %1 set speed PID Kp %2 Ki %3 Kd %4

pd42s1_set_pos_torque.message0: motor addr %1 set position max torque %2 mA
pd42s1_set_pos_torque.tooltip: Set the position-loop torque limit (100-3000 mA)

pd42s1_set_step.tooltip: Set microstepping (1-256); finer = smoother but less torque

pd42s1_set_ma.message0: motor addr %1 set target current (torque mode) %2 mA
pd42s1_set_ma.tooltip: Set target current (effective in torque mode only, 0-3000 mA)

pd42s1_set_uart_baud.message0: motor addr %1 set driver UART baud %2
pd42s1_set_uart_baud.tooltip: Set the driver UART baud; re-init with the new baud afterwards

pd42s1_set_can_baud.message0: motor addr %1 set CAN baud %2 Kbps
pd42s1_set_can_baud.tooltip: Set the driver CAN baud rate (in Kbps)

pd42s1_set_modbus.tooltip: Choose the custom protocol or MODBUS

pd42s1_set_clog_pro.tooltip: Enable or disable the stall protection

pd42s1_set_clog_current.message0: motor addr %1 set stall current %2 mA

pd42s1_set_can_id.tooltip: Set the CAN transmit ID (29-bit extended)

pd42s1_set_dir_level.tooltip: Set the DIR-pin level that means CW (for pulse/dir control)

pd42s1_set_en_level.tooltip: Set the EN pin active level (low / high / always active)

pd42s1_set_cmd_echo.tooltip: Set whether the driver replies with ack frames

pd42s1_set_key_lock.tooltip: Lock or unlock the driver panel keys

pd42s1_set_auto_display.tooltip: Enable or disable the driver screen auto-off

pd42s1_set_io_start_level.tooltip: Set the IO start-stop trigger level (start on LOW or HIGH)

pd42s1_origin_left_pos.message0: motor addr %1 set left limit origin %2
pd42s1_origin_left_pos.tooltip: Set the left limit origin position (51200 per turn)

pd42s1_origin_right_pos.message0: motor addr %1 set right limit origin %2
pd42s1_origin_right_pos.tooltip: Set the right limit origin position (51200 per turn)

pd42s1_origin_homing.message0: motor addr %1 find zero %2 dir %3 speed %4 RPM reach current %5 mA
pd42s1_origin_homing.tooltip: Find zero: without limit switch by stall current (200-1000 mA recommended), with limit switch by the switch; keep speed under 100 RPM

pd42s1_origin_trig.tooltip: Trigger the homing action: single-turn / nearest / multi-turn

pd42s1_origin_timeout.message0: motor addr %1 set homing timeout %2 ms

pd42s1_origin_auto.message0: motor addr %1 auto homing on power-up %2
pd42s1_origin_auto.tooltip: Set whether the driver homes automatically on power-up

pd42s1_origin_switch.tooltip: When enabled, the motion range is limited by the L/R limit origins

pd42s1_pulse_pin_init.message0: pulse pin init EN %1 STEP %2 DIR %3
pd42s1_pulse_pin_init.tooltip: Init the EN/STEP/DIR output pins (default 35/36/37 for DNESP32S3 wiring, change for other boards); use with the pulse-mode block

pd42s1_pulse_en.tooltip: Set the pulse-mode EN pin level (configure the EN active level protocol block first)

pd42s1_pulse_en_toggle.tooltip: Toggle the EN enable pin level

pd42s1_pulse_dir.tooltip: Set the pulse-mode DIR pin level (CW/CCW meaning is defined by the DIR-level protocol block)

pd42s1_pulse_dir_toggle.tooltip: Toggle the DIR pin level (reverses direction)

pd42s1_pulse_output.tooltip: Output the given pulse count on the STEP pin (software timing, speed not precise); 3200 pulses = 1 turn at 16 microsteps

pd42s1_pulse_freq_from_rpm.message0: pulse freq Hz for microstep %1 speed %2 RPM
pd42s1_pulse_freq_from_rpm.tooltip: Compute the pulse frequency for a target speed: freq = RPM×200×microstep÷60 (number output)

pd42s1_pulse_rpm_from_freq.message0: speed RPM for freq %1 Hz microstep %2
pd42s1_pulse_rpm_from_freq.tooltip: Compute the actual speed for a pulse frequency: RPM = freq×60÷(200×microstep) (number output)

pd42s1_io_pin_init.tooltip: Init the IO start-stop output pin (default 39 for DNESP32S3 wiring, change for other boards); use with the IO start-stop mode block

pd42s1_io_pin_set.tooltip: Set the IO start-stop pin level (the start level is defined by the IO-level protocol block)

pd42s1_io_pin_toggle.tooltip: Toggle the IO start-stop pin level (start/stop)
